classification.difficultyReason: Median of ungrouped stem-and-leaf data: count the values, find the median position, and average two middle values in part b. There is no scaffolding, but this is a single statistic, so it is easier than the four-statistic p35-q6.

content.prompt: Find the median of these stem-and-leaf plots. $1\mid 5$ means $15$.

answer.worked:
There are $11$ scores.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{11+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=6\end{align*}$$
The $6^{\mathrm{th}}$ score is $24$, so the median is $24$.

There are $12$ scores.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{12+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=6.5\end{align*}$$
The median is between the $6^{\mathrm{th}}$ and $7^{\mathrm{th}}$ scores, $68$ and $72$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{68+72}{2}\\\text{Median}&=70\end{align*}$$
